name: wsa-manager
description: Windows Subsystem for Android setup and app manager
author: Codex

scripts.validate: npm run check:repo && npm run typecheck && npm run test:main && npm run test:ui
scripts.build: npm run check:repo && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/write-build-info.mjs
scripts.package:unpacked: npm run release:clean && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --dir --x64 && node scripts/write-release-manifest.mjs unpacked && node scripts/check-release-layout.mjs unpacked
scripts.smoke:packaged: npm run package:unpacked && npm run smoke:packaged:ci
scripts.test:visual: npm run package:unpacked && npm run test:visual:ci
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run package:unpacked && playwright test tests/e2e/visual.packaged.spec.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.release:build: npm run release:clean && npm run dist
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --win --x64 && node scripts/write-release-manifest.mjs full && node scripts/check-release-layout.mjs full
